verdict.rationale: A state business-filing authority could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec for entity search or filings, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing bot walls on www.nvsos.gov and the ORION portal, with nothing about an OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
